title: CNC lathes
subtitle: Dener TTC and TTH slant-bed CNC lathes · 6″ to 12″ chucks · Ø22″ and Ø27.6″ swing · Fanuc control
about_title: Slant-bed CNC lathes from Dener's machine-tool plant
about_text: The TTC and TTH lathes share one design: a one-piece cast bed inclined at 45° that sheds chips into the conveyor, roller linear guides with C1 and C3 ballscrews coupled straight to the servo motors, a spindle on super-precision bearings, a 12-station servo turret that indexes in 0.2 s, a hydraulic chuck and a hydraulic tailstock, under a Fanuc 0i-TF Plus control (Mitsubishi M80 to order). The compact TTC-6 and TTC-8 swing Ø22″ (560 mm) with 6″ and 8″ chucks; the TTH-8, TTH-10 and TTH-12 swing Ø27.6″ (700 mm), turn parts up to Ø20.8″ × 26.8″ (528 × 680 mm) and go up to a 12″ chuck and 3.74″ (95 mm) bar. A BMT55 C-axis turret with 12 live tools turns any of them into a turn-mill centre.

Dener Makina has built machinery in Kayseri since 1974, and since 2016 CNC machine tools in the Taksan plant it took over: 155,000 m² of factory buildings where the castings are machined and the machines assembled. NovoTech sells, installs and supports the lathes in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, with a CSA-approved panel and a 1-year warranty.
